scope: Source-informed development probes authored before ranking. Targets are evaluation annotations only; the production projection has no page names, DOF constants or prewritten explanations. Exact-unit delivery is not answer correctness or complete applicability-context validation.

queries.query: Under the general Abaqus degree-of-freedom numbering convention, which numbers identify translations and rotations about the three Cartesian axes?
For axisymmetric Abaqus elements, what do degrees of freedom 1 and 2 represent, and how are rotational degrees of freedom distinguished for twist and shells?
In Abaqus input-file assembly naming conventions, how do qualified names distinguish a set belonging to a part instance from one belonging to an assembly?
When using the toolpath-mesh intersection module for controlled material deposition, which user subroutines set up the module data and determine element activation or deposited volume?
In Lanczos natural frequency extraction, how does the block size affect the maximum number of block Lanczos steps?
For triangular two-dimensional solid elements, how are face numbers associated with corner-node pairs?
